subject: Sir John Curtice: Burnham's win against Reform represents remarkable personal success

Andy Burnham, the Mayor of Greater Manchester, secured a by-election victory that bucked the trend of declining support for the governing Labour party, outperforming national expectations.

The Bright Side:
